name: X319
fix_description: claimEther (0xbfcf63b0) directly sends ETH/BNB to any address with any amount specified by the caller, with NO access control. Anyone can drain the contract entire balance. Fix by adding onlyOwner modifier.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-step exploit: deploying a contract whose constructor calls claimEther with tx.origin as receiver. The vulnerability appears to be a straightforward misuse of tx.origin or missing access control, requiring minimal protocol context and very little PoC logic.
